<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:paddingTop="30dp" android:paddingBottom="40dp" android:background="@color/vt5_black" android:orientation="vertical">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="10dp">
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnTerug" style="@style/Widget.VT5.Button.Outlined" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:minWidth="48dp" android:text="@string/instellingen_back_arrow" android:textSize="18sp" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="10dp" android:text="Overzicht" android:textColor="@color/vt5_on_surface" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnToonGrafieken" style="@style/Widget.VT5.Button" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="10dp" android:text="GRAFIEK" android:visibility="visible" /> </LinearLayout>
<View android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="1dp" android:alpha="0.3" android:background="@color/vt5_on_surface" />
<androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:fillViewport="true">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="10dp">
<AutoCompleteTextView android:id="@+id/atvSoortZoeken" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:backgroundTint="@color/vt5_on_surface" android:hint="@string/db_beheer_hint_soortnaam" android:textColor="@color/vt5_on_surface" android:textColorHint="@color/vt5_on_surface" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvSoortInfo" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:textColor="@color/vt5_on_surface" android:textSize="14sp" android:textStyle="italic" /> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/layoutGrafieken" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="10dp" android:visibility="gone">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvHeaderNoord" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Noord (N, NW, NNW, NO, NNO) - Totaal: 0" android:textColor="@color/vt5_light_blue" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" /> <com.patrykandpatrick.vico.views.cartesian.CartesianChartView android:id="@+id/chartNoord" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="120dp" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" android:background="@drawable/vt5_btn_shape_normal" android:padding="8dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvHeaderOost" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Oost (O, NO, NNO, OZO, ZZO) - Totaal: 0" android:textColor="@color/vt5_light_blue" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" /> <com.patrykandpatrick.vico.views.cartesian.CartesianChartView android:id="@+id/chartOost" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="120dp" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" android:background="@drawable/vt5_btn_shape_normal" android:padding="8dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvHeaderZuid" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Zuid (Z, ZZO, ZO, ZW, ZZW) - Totaal: 0" android:textColor="@color/vt5_light_blue" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" /> <com.patrykandpatrick.vico.views.cartesian.CartesianChartView android:id="@+id/chartZuid" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="120dp" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" android:background="@drawable/vt5_btn_shape_normal" android:padding="8dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvHeaderWest" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="West (W, WZW, ZW, NW, WNW) - Totaal: 0" android:textColor="@color/vt5_light_blue" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" /> <com.patrykandpatrick.vico.views.cartesian.CartesianChartView android:id="@+id/chartWest" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="120dp" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" android:background="@drawable/vt5_btn_shape_normal" android:padding="8dp" /> </LinearLayout>
<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/rvWaarnemingen" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false" android:padding="10dp" />
</LinearLayout> </androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView>
</LinearLayout>
